panel.membership_required_on_D: official_list_date <= D < official_delist_date; blank delist open-ended
panel.factor_history: Observed valid trading bars through D only; no imputation.
panel.rv10_over_rv60: population std(ddof=0) latest 10 log close returns / latest 60
panel.tr10_over_tr60: latest 10 mean true-range-percent / latest 60 mean true-range-percent
panel.dual_compression_score: 0.5*(1-rank_pct(rv)) + 0.5*(1-rank_pct(tr)) among rows where both factors are finite
panel.score_rank_percentile: average-rank percentile of dual_compression_score within signal date
panel.forward_D5_D10: Exact frozen joint-session targets from same frozen Tencent hfq source; no target shift.

daily_metrics.primary: mean(Q5 D10 return) - mean(Q1 D10 return)
daily_metrics.secondary: mean(Q5 D5 return) - mean(Q1 D5 return)
daily_metrics.supporting: mean(Q5 D10 return) - mean(all valid D10 returns)
daily_metrics.quintile_means: Daily mean return for each fixed score quintile band.

quintile_shape_gate: Q5 aggregate mean D10 return must be strictly greater than the aggregate daily-mean D10 return of Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4.
